landing.missionTitle: Physics: A journey into the depths of
landing.missionDesc1: Physics is the science that connects imagination with reality; it is the continuous human endeavor to understand how an electron moves around the nucleus and how galaxies collide in the far reaches of the universe.
landing.missionDesc2: In "Physics World", we strive to turn dry equations into vibrant visual experiences. We believe true understanding begins when we see science, not just hear about it. Join us to discover the forces that drive your life and shape your future.
landing.missionCard1Desc: The study of motion, forces, and the fundamental causes of interaction.
landing.missionCard2Desc: Exploring the microscopic world and the secrets of sub-atomic particles.
landing.featuresSubtitle: We integrate technology with science to provide an unforgettable learning experience.
landing.feature1Desc: Interactive video lessons that explain the hardest experiments and concepts in a simplified and fun way.
landing.feature2Desc: PDF documents that summarize the content and provide training exercises to enhance understanding.
landing.feature3Desc: Continuously measure your level through smart tests after every lesson.
